description: Trim video. Cut out a fragment by timecodes. The stream is copied without re-encoding, so it is fast and lossless. If the cut cannot land on a keyframe, we re-encode and say so. Accepts video/*, .mp4, .mov, .mkv, .webm, .avi, .m4v; up to 500 MB per file.

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

precise.description: Cut exactly on the marks. Slower, because it needs re-encoding

to.description: End point. Leave empty to cut to the end

name: video_trim
